question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: APPOSITE
solution:
The correct answer is: **Relevant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Apposite"** means highly appropriate or suitable for a particular situation or context. (उपयुक्त)

 
 
• **Example:** Her remarks during the meeting were apposite and helped resolve the issue effectively.
 
 
 
• **"Relevant"** refers to something that is directly connected with or pertinent to the matter at hand. (संबंधित)
 
 
• **Example:** The professor provided relevant examples to clarify the complex topic.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Apposite" is synonymous with "Relevant."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Relevant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Irrelevant** (असंबंधित): Not connected with or applicable to the matter at hand.

 
 
• **Example:** His comments during the discussion were irrelevant to the topic being addressed.
 
 
 
• **Vague** (अस्पष्ट): Not clearly expressed or defined; uncertain or ambiguous.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions provided were vague, leaving everyone confused.
 
 
 
• **Random** (अनियमित): Occurring without a specific pattern, purpose, or objective.
 
 
• **Example:** The numbers in the lottery are generated at random.
